name: HelpOfAi AIOS
description: HelpOfAi AIOS v1.x Enterprise — AI Software Engineering Operating System. A modular, offline-first, deterministic, enterprise-grade platform that plugs into HelpOfAi CLI to provide capability-based software engineering intelligence.

architecture.principle: AIOS loads only the capabilities needed for each request. The CLI is the shell; AIOS is the OS that shell runs on.

core_layers.name: constitution
core_layers.description: Immutable engineering laws and design principles

core_layers.name: registry
core_layers.description: Module, capability, dependency, feature, and prompt registries

core_layers.name: kernel
core_layers.description: Execution lifecycle, state machine, capability router, request parser

core_layers.name: runtime
core_layers.description: Job queue, scheduler, cache, event bus, resource manager, logging

core_layers.name: intelligence
core_layers.description: Planner, Project Brain, Memory, Knowledge Graph, Digital Twin

core_layers.name: engines
core_layers.description: Analysis, Feature, Code, Testing, Review, Security, DevOps engines

core_layers.name: agents
core_layers.description: Master agent, specialist agents, communication bus, orchestrator

core_layers.name: knowledge
core_layers.description: Framework packs, language packs, domain packs, architecture patterns

core_layers.name: ecosystem
core_layers.description: Plugin SDK, workflows, templates, studio, documentation

design_principle: HelpOfAi AIOS is a modular, offline-first, deterministic, enterprise-grade AI Software Engineering Operating System. It builds maintainable, secure, production-ready software through transparent reasoning, versioned knowledge, reusable workflows, and independently loadable modules.
golden_rule: AIOS exists to help engineers build maintainable, secure, production-ready software through deterministic workflows, transparent reasoning, and modular architecture. AIOS must optimize for correctness, maintainability, and long-term value over speed alone.
